{{Quote|GREGOR-39<br />5576-39<br />SGT 1ST CLASS<br />212 ATTACK BATTALION<br />FOXTROT GROUP|From Gregor's file in the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] military database|<ref name="MIA">{{TCW|Missing in Action}}</ref>}}
'''Foxtrot Group''' was an elite [[Squad/Legends|squad]] of [[Clone commando/Legends|clone commandos]] attached to the [[212th Attack Battalion/Legends|212th Attack Battalion]].<ref name="MIA" /> The group was led by [[Clone Captain/Legends|clone trooper captain]] [[Gregor/Legends|Gregor]],<ref name="Episode Guide" /> who went missing during the [[Battle of Sarrish/Legends|Battle of Sarrish]].<ref name="MIA" />
